tiling_and_loop_order.evidence: Mapping.cc:25-49 reads an optional *.mapping file of [T]/[O]/[I] loop tuples

core_mapping_per_tile.evidence: Scheduler.cc:76-92 honours tile->core_id but nothing external can set it; only model-level target_core and config partiton_map exist (Common.h:124 defaults core_id=-1)

cross_operator_pipelining.evidence: Scheduler.cc:207-209 issues the next layer only when every per-core queue is empty and count_active_layers()==0

same_core_cross_operator_residency.evidence: Core.cc:36-74 flushes scratchpad per tile; accumulator preserved only within one fused op (Core.cc:54-58); outputs go back to DRAM

buffer_depth_and_capacity.evidence: Sram.cc:6-10 fixed capacity spad_size/2; overflow asserts (Sram.cc:48-50) or exits (Core.cc:338-342)

explicit_slot_reuse.evidence: AddressAllocator.h is an abstract base and is unused at runtime

core_to_core_communication.evidence: Simulator.cc:269-275 routes every request to DRAM and every response to a core

dependency_and_resource_order.evidence: per-op tile dependencies plus the scheduler's ready handling

policy_replacement.evidence: Scheduler::create factory (Scheduler.cc:4-20) selects a Scheduler subclass from config

dram_noc_backpressure.evidence: booksim2/ramulator2 report is_full(); with icnt_type=simple, Interconnect.cc:63-66 always returns false, i.e. NO backpressure

self_timed_execution.evidence: Simulator.cc:107-210 advances by actual tile completion, no global barrier

silu_swish.evidence: BiasAct.cc:7 handles 'swish'; no standalone SiLU op

elementwise_multiply.evidence: Opcode::MUL only emitted inside the fused llama-MLP BiasAct (BiasAct.cc:126-134)

precision_cast.evidence: Cast maps to a Dummy no-op (OperationFactory.cc:48-49)

build_blocked_by: cmake: absent on host and not obtainable (PyPI returns an HTML interception page)
git submodules onnx/protobuf/booksim/ramulator2: not fetchable through the truncating proxy
gcc: available (MinGW), but C++20 + conan + cmake are all required
capability_blocked_by: cross-operator scratchpad residency is not supported (Core.cc)
core-to-core data exchange is not supported (Simulator.cc)
simple scheduler imposes a whole-layer completion barrier (Scheduler.cc)
